insight: Built by Beijing's TimedomAIn; its 140+ royalty-free voices span 8 languages, and a paid subscription converts into a lifetime license.
name: ACE Studio
tagline: AI music studio for studio-quality singing vocals from MIDI and lyrics.
description: ACE Studio generates expressive, human-like singing vocals from MIDI and lyrics, edited in a piano-roll where you control pitch, timing, vibrato, pronunciation, dynamics, and emotional intensity. It ships 140+ royalty-free AI voice models across eight languages, plus AI instruments, voice cloning, stem splitting, and choir/ensemble modes. It runs as a standalone desktop app and as VST/AU/AAX plugins, with vocal generation processed in the cloud.

modelSupport.notes: Ships its own AI vocal and instrument models; supports cloning from your samples.

edge: Unlike text-to-song generators, it gives piano-roll control over pitch, vibrato, and emotion for studio-grade singing built from your MIDI and lyrics.
pros: Runs as standalone app and DAW plugin
Voice cloning from your own samples
cons: Needs MIDI + lyrics, not just a prompt
Vocal rendering processed in the cloud
Learning curve for the piano-roll editor

references.title: ACE Studio 2.0 is an AI music studio for AI-generated vocals and instruments
